name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio: Gareth’s journey into motorsport catering was rather circuitous, starting with a small family-run pub in his hometown near Cardiff. He honed his skills serving hearty meals to locals, eventually expanding into catering for local events. A chance encounter with a Hitech Development team member at a regional rally led to an opportunity to manage their trackside catering. Gareth prides himself on providing nutritious and comforting meals for the team, understanding the importance of morale and energy levels during grueling race weekends. His knack for adapting menus to diverse dietary needs and sourcing fresh, local ingredients sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Gareth is a stocky man with a friendly face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas.
Insists on personally taste-testing every dish before it's served.
Has a habit of humming Welsh folk songs while prepping meals.
